# Mousa Alfaify

> Operations Control Specialist at the Saudi Red Crescent Authority, working across
> governance, risk, compliance, operations, data and automation. Based in Riyadh,
> Saudi Arabia. Published in Arabic and English.

## Practice

Building the systems that connect a control framework to daily operational data and to
the decision actually being made — rather than producing policy documents or dashboards
in isolation.

- [Arabic edition](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/?lang=ar): the primary edition of the site.
- [English edition](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/?lang=en): full English translation.

## Selected work

- [Operational Control System](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/#work): ISO 9001 applied to the data cycle of a national ambulatory command centre — 12+ KPIs, automated validation, a live Power BI board. Data accuracy 92% to 99.2%; operational errors down 45%.
- [Smart Performance Dashboard](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/#work): 15+ medical response indicators monitored around the clock with threshold-driven alerts.
- [Smart Paramedic Assistant](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/#work): AI assistant answering 500+ field queries a day at 94% accuracy, grounded in the approved operational reference.
- [Smart Data Analyst](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/#work): automated reporting saving 20 working hours a week at 98% analytical accuracy.
- [Administrative Writing Guide](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/#work): the official approved writing standard turned into a verification layer across 200+ document types.
- [Internal Communications System](https://mousa-alfaify.github.io/#work): employee engagement lifted from 35% to 68% across 6 departments and 500+ staff; 22+ campaigns delivered.
